title: diagnostic gate -- FP/mask-budget, free-cell coupling, 30/43 split
hypothesis: cheap structural diagnostics re-price the homophonic attack menu: the mask budget, the joint-decode cell dimension, and the exact selector-locked/prior-determined split
best_partial: FP/mask-pass 2^-10 (N_max=52); 43 free cells (not 73); split 30 selector-locked / 43 prior-determined
insights: (A) COLOURING-PASS FP RATE = 0.000976562 = 2^-10.0 (check 16384/2^24 = 0.000976562). Per-component: eight 2-cliques at p=1/2, one 3-node path at p=1/4, five isolated at p=1. => A random selector mask 2-colours the cribs ~0.1% of the time. MASK BUDGET: testing up to N_max=52 structured masks keeps the family-wise colouring-pass false positive under 5% -- beyond that, a colouring-pass is expected by chance and must clear the decrypt null (106/111), not just the colouring test.

(B) FREE-CELL COUPLING: the 73 free positions use 22 distinct ciphertext letters; the joint chart-aware decode therefore has at most 43 free cells (chart x cipher-letter) -- NOT 73 independent letters. 1 ciphertext letter(s) occur once among free positions. This 43-cell space (vs 73) is the true dimension of T1-A/T2-E and the ceiling on what a joint n-gram decode can resolve.

(C) THE SPLIT (exact): 30 SELECTOR-LOCKED free positions (ciphertext letter is crib-pinned -> chart entry known -> only the selector bit free -> 0.50 coin-flip; movable ONLY by a selector-coupled M1/M2 fact) and 43 PRIOR-DETERMINED (ciphertext letter never in cribs -> both chart entries free -> decided by the deterministic plaintext prior). Path A owns the 43; Path B (selector-coupled) owns the 30.

(C-proxy) Of the 43 prior-determined positions, 0 are singletons (unique free cipher letter -> decided by n-gram CONTEXT alone, no cross-position tie) and the rest fall in 12 tied groups (decided JOINTLY -- repeated cipher letter forces equal plaintext within a chart). Tied groups are where the homophonic structure adds decode leverage beyond a plain per-position n-gram.
next_steps: T1-B selector-mask harness must cap at N_max masks and clear the decrypt null, not just the colouring test (122)
T1-A chart-tie + T2-E joint decode operate over the 43-cell space, not 73 letters (121/124)
Path A (plaintext prior) targets the 43 prior-determined; Path B (selector-coupled) targets the 30 selector-locked -- build both, they are disjoint
